name: Barbell Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall on a sturdy box with feet close together and knees straight, holding a light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin to your chest and round slowly downward one vertebra at a time, letting the bar glide past your toes.
Pause briefly at the bottom of your comfortable range while breathing calmly and keeping your knees straight.
Reverse the curl slowly from your pelvis up through your lower back, upper back, and neck to stand tall again.
tips: Use light load and slow, deliberate control through every segment of your spine.
Keep your knees straight without hyperextending them and stay within a pain-free range of motion.
